bug_report:
Passing component of a parameter array to a subroutine causes SIGBUS crash
Consider the following program:

module test_mod
contains
subroutine match_word (names)
implicit none
character(*) names(:)
end subroutine
end module

program test
use test_mod
implicit none

type pp_struct
  character(40) name
  real value
end type

type (pp_struct), parameter :: pp(2) = [ &
                 pp_struct('pi', 3.1), &
                 pp_struct('twopi', 6.3)]

print *, 'In'
call match_word(pp%name)
print *, 'Out'
end program



Compiling and running produces:

Davids-Mac-mini:~/Downloads> gfortran test.f90; ./a.out 
 In

Program received signal SIGBUS: Access to an undefined portion of a memory object.

Backtrace for this error:
#0  0x105ff50bc
#1  0x105ff48aa
#2  0x7fffb3bd6b39
#3  0x105fecd68
#4  0x105fece2e
Bus error: 10

Note: If "parameter" is not used with the pp array, the program runs fine.
